user.title: Met Office Maps
user.description: Connect a Met Office DataHub Map Images order. You'll find the key and the order ID in the [DataHub portal]({datahub_url}). Checking them uses one of today's requests.

data_description.api_key: Stored only in Home Assistant. It is never sent to your dashboards.
data_description.order_id: For example o123456789012. Capital letters are fine: it is converted to lower case.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the API key
reauth_confirm.description: The Met Office rejected the key for order {order_id}. Enter a new one. Checking it uses one of today's requests.

error.invalid_auth: The Met Office rejected this API key.
error.order_not_found: No order with this ID was found for this key.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Met Office DataHub. Try again later.
error.budget_exhausted: Today's request budget for this order is used up. Try again after midnight UTC.

abort.already_configured: This order is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The API key has been updated.

data_description.daily_cap: The free plan allows 1,000 requests a day, reset at 00:00 UTC. At the cap, polling stops and the last frames stay on show.
data_description.poll_minutes: Each check uses one request. New frames use one request each.

order_not_found.title: Met Office order not found
order_not_found.description: The Met Office no longer recognises the order for {title}. Polling has stopped. Check the order in the DataHub portal, then reload the integration or set it up again.

entry_not_loaded.message: That Met Office Maps entry is not loaded.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Check for new forecast frames now. Uses the daily request budget like any other check.

config_entry_id.name: Order
config_entry_id.description: Only refresh this order. Leave empty to refresh all of them.
